name: Turkmenistan

wildFacts.text: The election passed power from President Gurbanguly Berdimuhamedov to his son Serdar after he called for a handover to "young leaders".
Officially, 9 candidates ran and 3,362,052 of 3,460,080 registered voters cast ballots.

notes: All figures officially reported (Central Election Commission via government site). ODIHR notes lack of political pluralism and deployed no observation mission. 2023 Mejlis (125 seats) results and 2026 by-election turnout not confirmed: omitted.
